descriere_scurta: CU analog input actual value in percent
descriere: Displays the currently referred input value of the analog input of the CU310-2. When interconnected, the signals are referred to the reference quantities p200x and p205x. Index: [0] = AI0 (X131.7, 8)
Sets the type of analog inputs of the CU310-2.

descriere_scurta: CU analog input characteristic value y1
descriere: Sets the scaling characteristic for the analog input of the CU310-2. The scaling characteristic for the analog inputs is defined using 2 points. This parameter specifies the y coordinate (percentage) of the 1st value pair of the characteristic. Index: [0] = AI0 (X131.7, 8)

descriere_scurta: CU analog input wire breakage monitoring response threshold
descriere: Sets the response threshold for the wire breakage monitoring of the analog input. The unit for the parameter value depends on the set analog input type. Index: [0] = AI0 (X131.7, 8)
Sets the offset for the analog input. The offset is added to the input signal before the scaling characteristic. Index: [0] = AI0 (X131.7, 8)

descriere_scurta: CU analog input activate absolute value generation
descriere: Activates the absolute value generation of the analog input signal.

descriere_scurta: CU analog input signal source for inversion
descriere: Sets the signal source to invert the analog input signals. Index: [0] = AI0 (X131.7, 8)

descriere_scurta: CU analog input window to suppress noise
descriere: Sets the noise suppression window for the analog input. Changes less than the window are suppressed. Index: [0] = AI0 (X131.7, 8)

descriere_scurta: CU analog input enable signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source to enable the analog input. Index: [0] = AI0 (X131.7, 8)

Displays the scaling of the signal to be output. A change in the output voltage by 1 volt corresponds to the value in this parameter. The units are determined by the interconnected test signal. Index: [0] = T0 [1] = T1 [2] = T2

descriere_scurta: Test sockets physical address signal value
descriere: Displays the actual value of a signal determined via a physical address. Index: [0] = T0 [1] = T1 [2] = T2
Sets the limit for a signal to be output via test sockets.

descriere_scurta: SI signal source for STO (SH)/SS1 (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the signal source for the following functions on the Control Unit: STO: Safe Torque Off / SH: Safe standstill SS1: Safe Stop 1 (time monitored)

descriere_scurta: CU analog input simulation mode setpoint
descriere: Sets the setpoint for the input value in the simulation mode of the analog input of the CU310-2. Index: [0] = AI0 (X131.7, 8)
Copies one Command Data Set (CDS) into another. Index: [0] = Source Command Data Set [1] = Target Command Data Set [2] = Start copying procedure
Copies one Drive Data Set (DDS) into another. Index: [0] = Source Drive Data Set [1] = Target Drive Data Set [2] = Start copying procedure
Displays the drive data set (DDS) selected via the binector input.
Displays the status word of the motor changeover. These signals can be connected to digital outputs to change over the motor.

descriere_scurta: Motor changeover status word bit number
descriere: Sets the bit number for every motor data set.
Sets the signal source for the feedback signal of the contactors when changing over motors. There is a fixed inter-relationship between energizing the contactor and the feedback signal.
Sets the signal source for jog 2.
Sets the signal source for the command "unconditionally close holding brake".

Displays the operational readiness of the infeeds when using Smart Line Module (SLM) and Basic Line Module (BLM) together (mixed operation). In order that signal BO: r0873 is available at one of the infeeds, then BI: p0874 of the one infeed must be interconnected to BO: r0863.0 of the other infeed.

descriere_scurta: Vdc controller or Vdc monitoring configuration
descriere: Sets the configuration of the controller or monitoring for the DC link voltage (Vdc).
Is used to assign the process data to be sent to the master (PZD, actual values).

descriere_scurta: PB/PN controller sign of life diagnostics
descriere: Displays how often the sign-of-life from the clock synchronous PROFIBUS/PROFINET controller last failed. An appropriate fault is output when the tolerance, specified in p0925, is exceeded.

Displays the operating mode. 1: Closed-loop speed controlled operation with ramp-function generator 2: Closed-loop position controlled operation 3: Closed-loop speed controlled operation without ramp-function generator
Displays the system runtime in milliseconds when the fault was removed.
Displays the diagnostic attribute of the fault which has occurred.
Displays the corresponding value for the PROFIBUS baud rate.

Sets the device target topology in coded form (refer to r0098). The setting is made during commissioning. De-activated or non-available components are also counted Index: [0] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X100 [1] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X101 [2] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X102 [3] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X103 [4] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X104 [5] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X105
Displays the parameters that exist for this drive.
Displays those parameters with a value other than the factory setting for this drive.

descriere_scurta: Macro Connector Inputs (CI) for speed setpoints
descriere: Displays the ACX file saved in the appropriate directory in the non-volatile memory.
Displays the number of the selected fixed speed/velocity setpoint.
Displays the selected and effective fixed velocity setpoint. This setpoint is the output value for the fixed velocity setpoints and must be appropriately interconnected (e.g. with the main setpoint).

Sets the ramp-up time for the internal ramp-function generator for the motorized potentiometer. The setpoint is changed from zero up to the speed/velocity limit (p1082) within this time (if no initial rounding-off has been activated).

Sets the signal source to continuously lower the setpoint for the motorized potentiometer. The setpoint change (CO: r1050) depends on the set ramp-down time (p1048) and the duration of the signal that is present (BI: p1036).
Sets the minimum speed/velocity for the motorized potentiometer.

Sets the signal source to change over from manual to automatic when using a motorized potentiometer. In the manual mode, the setpoint is changed using two signals - raise and lower. In the automatic mode, the setpoint must be interconnected via a connector input.

descriere_scurta: Mot. potentiom. velocity setp. in front of ramp-fct. gen.
descriere: Sets the effective setpoint in front of the internal motorized potentiometer ramp-function generator.

descriere_scurta: Motor. potentiometer setpoint after the ramp-function generator /
descriere: Sets the effective setpoint after the internal motorized potentiometer ramp-function generator. This setpoint is the output value of the motorized potentiometer and must be appropriately interconnected onwards (e.g. with the main setpoint).
Sets the signal source for the main setpoint.
Sets the velocity for jog 1. Jogging (JOG) is level-triggered, and allows the motor to be incrementally traversed.
Displays the total effective setpoint. The value indicates the sum of the effective main setpoint and supplementary setpoint.
Displays the effective main setpoint. The value shown is the main setpoint after scaling.
Displays the effective supplementary setpoint. The value shown is the additional setpoint after scaling.
Sets the signal source for lowest possible motor speed.
Sets the maximum motor speed.

descriere_scurta: Motor pole pair number, actual (or calculated)
descriere: Displays the number of motor pole pairs. The value is used for internal calculations.
Sets the signal source for the velocity limit of the positive direction.
Display and connector output for the active positive velocity limit.
Sets the signal source for the speed/velocity limit of the negative direction.
Display and connector output for the active negative velocity limit.
Sets the bandwidth for the skip velocities 1 to 4.
Sets the bandwidth for the skip speeds/velocities 1 to 4.
Sets the lowest possible motor velocity. This value is not undershot in operation.
Displays the velocity setpoint after the minimum limiting.
Displays the speed/velocity setpoint after the changeover and limiting the direction.

descriere_scurta: Ramp-function generator setpoint at the input
descriere: Displays the setpoint at the input of the ramp-function generator.
Sets the signal source for scaling the ramp-up time of the ramp-function generator.
Sets the signal source for scaling the ramp-down time of the ramp-function generator.
The ramp-function generator ramps-up the speed setpoint from standstill (setpoint = 0) up to the maximum speed (p1082) in this time.
Displays the status word for the ramp-function generator (RFG).
Displays the acceleration of the ramp-function generator.

descriere_scurta: Ramp-function generator velocity setpoint at the output
descriere: Displays the setpoint at the output of the ramp-function generator.
Sets the denominator damping for velocity setpoint filter 1 (PT2, general filter).
Displays the velocity setpoint after the addition of the velocity setpoint 1 (p1155) and velocity setpoint 2 (p1160).
Sets the signal source for speed setpoint 2 of the speed controller.
Sets the number of the encoder used for DSC.

descriere_scurta: DSC symmetrizing time constant additive T_SYMM_ADD
descriere: Set the additive symmetrizing time constant T_SYMM_ADD for the velocity precontrol value for active force precontrol.
Display and connector output of the position setpoint of DSC in fine pulses.
Sets the signal source to select the fixed velocity setpoint.
Displays the status of the automatic restart (AR).
Sets the monitoring time of the automatic restart (AR). Index: [0] = Restart [1] = Reset start counter

Sets the velocity threshold for the standstill identification. Acts on the actual value and setpoint monitoring. When braking with OFF1 or OFF3, when the threshold is undershot, standstill is identified.
Sets the braking current for DC braking.
Sets the integral time for DC braking (p1230, p1231).

descriere_scurta: Armature short-circuit / DC braking status word
descriere: Displays the status word for armature short-circuit.
Displays the state for the external armature short-circuit.

descriere_scurta: External armature short-circuit contactor feedback signal
descriere: Sets the signal source for the contactor feedback signal for external armature short-circuit.
Sets the force offset for the force limit.
Sets the regenerative power limit.
Displays the actual output of the Vdc controller (DC link voltage controller)
Displays the status word for the line-drive synchronization.
Displays the status word for the motor holding brake.

Displays the switch-in level for the Vdc_max controller. If p1294 = 0 (automatic sensing of the switch-in level = off), then the following applies: AC/AC device: r1282 = 1.15 * sqrt(2) * p0210 DC/AC device: r1282 = 1.15 * p0210 If p1294 = 1 (automatic sensing of the switch-in level = on), then the following applies:
Displays the switch-in level for the Vdc_min controller (kinetic buffering).

Sets the dynamic factor for the Vdc_min controller (kinetic buffering). 100% means that p1290, p1291, and p1292 (gain, integral time, and rate time) are used corresponding to their basic settings and based on a theoretical controller optimization. If subsequent optimization is required, this can be carried out using the dynamic factor. In this case, p1290, p1291, and p1292 are weighted with the dynamic factor p1287. If several modules are connected to the DC link, then the dynamic factor must be increased corresponding to the ratio of the additional capacitances to the capacitance of the module involved.

descriere_scurta: Change over between closed-loop speed/torque control
descriere: Sets the signal source for toggling between speed and torque control. 0 signal: Closed-loop speed control 1 signal: Closed-loop torque control
Displays the actual output of the Vdc controller (DC link voltage controller)

descriere_scurta: Ramp-function gen. tolerance for ramp-up and ramp-down active
descriere: Sets the tolerance value for the status of the ramp-function generator (ramp-up active, ramp-down active). If the input of the ramp-function generator does not change in comparison to the output by more than the entered tolerance time, then the status bits "ramp-up active" and "ramp-down active" are not influenced.
Displays the total resulting voltage boost in volt.

p1311 only results in a voltage boost when accelerating and generates a supplementary torque to accelerate the load. The voltage boost becomes effective for a positive setpoint increase and disappears as soon as the setpoint has been reached. The build-up and withdrawal of the voltage boost are smoothed. The magnitude of the boost in Volt at a frequency of zero is defined as follows: Voltage boost [V] = 1.732 * p0305 (rated motor current [A]) x r0395 (stator/primary section resistance [ohm]) x p1311 (voltage boost when accelerating [%]) / 100 %
Sets the open and closed-loop control mode of a drive.
The linear characteristic for the U/f control is defined by 0 Hz / p1319 and p1326 / p1327. This parameter specifies the voltage of the upper point along the characteristic.
The linear characteristic for the U/f control is defined by 0 Hz / p1319 and p1326 / p1327. This parameter specifies the voltage of the upper point along the characteristic.
Sets the setpoint for slip compensation in [%] referred to r0330 (motor rated slip).
Displays the actual compensated slip [%] referred to r0330 (rated motor slip).

descriere_scurta: U/f mode resonance damping maximum frequency
descriere: Sets the maximum output frequency for resonance damping for U/f control. Resonance damping is inactive above this output frequency.
